<robot name="chaos_demo_ugv">
  <material name="body_blue"><color rgba="0.12 0.35 0.60 1" /></material>
  <material name="wheel_gray"><color rgba="0.15 0.15 0.15 1" /></material>
  <material name="sensor_orange"><color rgba="0.95 0.45 0.10 1" /></material>

  <link name="base_link">
    <visual>
      <geometry><box size="0.6 0.4 0.2" /></geometry>
      <material name="body_blue" />
    </visual>
  </link>
  <link name="left_wheel_link">
    <visual>
      <origin rpy="1.5707963267948966 0 0" />
      <geometry><cylinder radius="0.08" length="0.04" /></geometry>
      <material name="wheel_gray" />
    </visual>
  </link>
  <joint name="left_wheel_joint" type="continuous">
    <parent link="base_link" /><child link="left_wheel_link" />
    <origin xyz="0 0.23 -0.1" /><axis xyz="0 1 0" />
    <limit effort="1" velocity="4" />
  </joint>
  <link name="right_wheel_link">
    <visual>
      <origin rpy="1.5707963267948966 0 0" />
      <geometry><cylinder radius="0.08" length="0.04" /></geometry>
      <material name="wheel_gray" />
    </visual>
  </link>
  <joint name="right_wheel_joint" type="continuous">
    <parent link="base_link" /><child link="right_wheel_link" />
    <origin xyz="0 -0.23 -0.1" /><axis xyz="0 1 0" />
    <limit effort="1" velocity="4" />
  </joint>
  <link name="body_imu_link">
    <visual>
      <geometry><box size="0.03 0.02 0.01" /></geometry>
      <material name="sensor_orange" />
    </visual>
  </link>
  <joint name="body_imu_mount" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base_link" /><child link="body_imu_link" />
    <origin xyz="0.1 0 0.11" />
  </joint>
</robot>
